items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: You mentioned the name Val-to. It sounds like a French name. ... I heard them call the name Val-to. I know it starts with a V. It might be. Now it could be Bal-to too.

ctx.x: There be a rough crowd all the time. Them fellas from here goes over there to the dancers. Them guys over there, see them feeling aching with them girls or something. They all like that. They all make up a crowd, you see. And I'm sorry for the guy who would be. Yeah. They beat him up something terrible. The sheriff that night said, nobody interfere. Leave him fight. They want to fight, leave him fight. And they fit in a roller in the automobile and all that water and ice. I said I already see it's him and me.…
How do you spell that name? I wouldn't know. I heard them call the name Val-to. I know it starts with a V. It might be. Now it could be Bal-to too. It wouldn't have to be Val-to. It could be Bal-to.

Some of those French names start with F when they pronounce it V too. Yeah. Like I'm thinking of a clarinetist up in Chicago, Val-e-Difo. Val-e-Difo. Val-e-Difo. Vo. Something they call it Faux and some V-e-difo. I think sometimes those names . Well look at this story . It should be Val-to . It should be Val-to .
